# Decision record

Use this to reopen a trainwreck, to pick a license, or to choose between two legal options inside a chapter (fixture vs proxy, ghost vs live presence, USGS vs OSM). Commit the record before the code that depends on it.

```
# D-<n> — <the choice in one line>

Date:
Chapter:
Decider: lead pilot | student (lead pilot agreed)

## The choice

What we will do.

## The other choice

What we will not do. Name it without insulting it. It was a real option.

## What we give up

The cost, in the player's seat and in the repo.

## What would make us reverse this

A concrete change, not "if we have time".

## Promise rewritten

If this contradicts docs/00 or docs/07, paste the new sentence and edit that
doc in this same commit. If you cannot write the new sentence, you cannot
make the choice.
```
